DECISION: Adopt automated risk scoring at ingest with a mandatory override by Data Protection, but route only the top 10% highest-scored links for human review—this balances speed and safety.

Result: Link coverage pushes +5%/day without choking on edge cases.
Owner: Data Protection owns the override and false-positive rate testing.
